data.name: Kifah
data.gender_notes: Kifah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who strives, makes an effort, engages in a battle or a war. The name Kifah carries the meaning “Struggle, Effort, Battle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kifah usually hope their child will grow to embody struggle, effort, battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodies the spirit of determination, resilience, and courage in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Kifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Struggle, Effort, Battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kifah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: كفاح
in_arabic.meaning: الجهاد في سبيل الله، النضال من أجل الحق
in_arabic.long_meaning: كفاح هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ك-ف-ح' والذي يعني الجهاد في سبيل الله، النضال من أجل الحق. ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا' (العنكبوت: 69). يعتبر اسم كفاح من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الإلتزام بالدين والشخصية القوية.

in_urdu.name: کفاح
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی راہ میں جدوجہد، حق کے لئے نبرد آزما
in_urdu.long_meaning: کفاح ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ك-ف-ح' جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی راہ میں جدوجہد، حق کے لئے نبرد آزما۔ یہ جڑ قرآن مجید میں کئی جگہوں پر ذکر کی گئی ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی: 'والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا' (العنكبوت: 69)। نام کفاح دین کے ساتھ وابستگی اور مضبوط شخصیت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: किफाह
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर के लिए संघर्ष, सच्चाई के लिए प्रयास
in_hindi.long_meaning: किफाह एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ك-ف-ح' मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वर के लिए संघर्ष, सच्चाई के लिए प्रयास। यह मूल कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर पाया जाता है, जैसे कि 'والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا' (العنكبوت: 69)। किफाह नाम धर्म के प्रति समर्पण और मजबूत व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: کفاح
in_pashto.meaning: د خدای لپاره جهاد، د حق لپاره مبارزه
in_pashto.long_meaning: کفاح د عربي ژبې يو نوم دی چې د 'ك-ف-ح' ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، مانا يې د خدای لپاره جهاد، د حق لپاره مبارزه. دا ريښه په قرآن کريم کې په ډيرو ځايونو کې ياد شوې ده، لکه: 'والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا' (العنكبوت: 69). د کفاح نوم د دين سره تړاو او قوي شخصيت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Kifah
in_english.meaning: Struggle, effort, or striving for what is right
in_english.long_meaning: Kifah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ك-ف-ح' (k-f-h), which means to struggle or strive for what is right. This root is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Ankabut, verse 69: 'And those who strive in Our cause, We shall certainly guide them.' Kifah signifies commitment to one's faith, strong will, and the pursuit of righteousness. It is a name that reflects resilience, determination, and spiritual dedication.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kifah" carries a strong and powerful connotation in Islamic culture. Historically, it represents warriors, fighters, and those who engage in battles for the sake of their faith and their community. In modern times, the name may be given to individuals who embody this spirit of struggle, determination, and resilience, whether through personal achievement, activism, or involvement in community causes.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Kifah" resonates with the concept of jihad, or struggle, in the Islamic tradition. It underscores the importance of striving in the path of righteousness and pursuing personal and spiritual growth. The name emphasizes the value of contributing to the betterment of one's self and one's community, and the rewards that come from making an effort in both the material and spiritual worlds. As a reminder of the ongoing struggle to live a virtuous life, the name "Kifah" inspires individuals to continually strive towards being their best selves, staying focused on their spiritual goals, and remaining committed to their faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Struggle, Effort, Battle" symbolizes The one who strives, makes an effort, engages in a battle or a war. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kifah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of struggle, effort, battle.
